name: SERPBear Ranking Report
description: Analyze one domain’s tracked SERPBear keyword rankings and save a dated SEO report in Baserow.
requirements: Reachable canonical HTTPS SERPBear /api/keywords endpoint and bearer API key in a secret Variable; the ranking read must finish within 30 seconds and 4 MiB
OpenRouter connection with credits for the paid meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct route; source free route currently has no endpoints
Baserow Cloud database-token connection with create-row permission and a table containing Date, Note and Blog
Configure tracked domain/blog label, Baserow table ID and Sunday 00:00 UTC schedule
